source: Native Excel Format Cells Alignment tab after opening /private/tmp/s3-cellstyle-alignment-probe.xlsx
interpretation: The named parent style is linked by xfId, but only cell XF defines the currently applied format. Editing a cell alignment must not copy parent wrap/indent into the cell XF merely because xfId points to that style.
observation_limits: The fixture was opened for read-only inspection; no edits were saved in native Excel.
